faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: No. {brand} filters and books. Your team closes — but now only with pre-qualified leads and full conversation context.
faq.q2: Does it work with listing portals like Zonaprop or Argenprop?
faq.a2: Yes. We connect the WhatsApp number tied to your Zonaprop, Argenprop, MercadoLibre or any portal listings. Leads land in the chat and {brand} qualifies them before passing to your team.
faq.q3: Can it book visits directly into my calendar?
faq.a3: Yes, via Google Calendar or your CRM's calendar. {brand} sees the agent's real availability and reserves the slot inside the conversation.
faq.q4: Does it work with HubSpot, Salesforce or Pipedrive?
faq.a4: Yes, via API. Available on Pro plan and above. Each lead is qualified, created as a contact, and conversations are auto-logged.
faq.a5: You do. The data lives in your storage, not ours. You can export it anytime or ask us to delete it.
faq.q6: How does it connect with my current WhatsApp?
faq.a6: In 5 minutes via Meta Embedded Signup. We help you register a WhatsApp Business number or port the one you already use.
faq.q7: What happens if a buyer asks something very complex?
faq.a7: {brand} hands off to a human agent with the full conversation context. The customer never waits and never gets a wrong answer.
faq.a8: Yes, via Stripe or Mercado Pago. Monthly or annual subscription with 15% off on annual. Bank transfer accepted for annual.
